title: DHCT-GAN v2
subtitle: Paper variant

nodes.title: Context channels
description: Epochs are convolutional input channels; keep the noisy centre.

nodes.title: Shared CNN / Transformer
description: CNN stem; encoder levels with local and global attention.
Configurable repeated LGTB blocks and paper-style local blocks.

nodes.title: Shared bottleneck
description: Process deepest features before splitting into decoder branches.

nodes.title: Clean decoder branch
description: Upsample, concatenate encoder skips, CNN refinement.

nodes.title: Artifact decoder branch
description: Independent decoder weights with the same encoder skips.

nodes.title: Gated clean fusion
description: Two independent tanh masks combine clean and input-minus-artifact.

nodes.title: Returned waveform
description: forward returns noisy centre - fused clean.

edges.label: Context channels to Shared CNN / Transformer
Shared CNN / Transformer to Shared bottleneck
Shared bottleneck to Clean decoder branch
Shared bottleneck to Artifact decoder branch
Clean decoder branch to Gated clean fusion
Artifact decoder branch to Gated clean fusion
Gated clean fusion to Returned waveform

notes: Discriminators and adversarial objectives are training-only; they are not in the inference signal path.
Experimental paper_accurate package; this depicts repository behavior, not a claim of complete paper equivalence.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
